g.text: J3 front switch: 1 contact NO (white), 2 common (yellow), 3 LED + (red), 4 LED - (black)

g.desc: J3 front switch: 1 contact NO (white), 2 common (yellow), 3 LED + (red), 4 LED - (black)

g.text: Optional: Schottky D1 in the +5VSB line (about 0.3 V drop).

g.desc: Optional: Schottky D1 in the +5VSB line (about 0.3 V drop).

g.text: JP1 is closed (R4 bypassed). Cut JP1 and fit R4 if the sense current is too high.

g.desc: JP1 is closed (R4 bypassed). Cut JP1 and fit R4 if the sense current is too high.

g.text: Optional: LED sense series resistor R4 (470R).

g.desc: Optional: LED sense series resistor R4 (470R).

g.text: Active buzzer, driven directly from GPIO4 (firmware sets maximum drive strength)

g.desc: Active buzzer, driven directly from GPIO4 (firmware sets maximum drive strength)

g.text: With D1 NOT fitted: never connect USB and +5VSB at the same time.

g.desc: With D1 NOT fitted: never connect USB and +5VSB at the same time.

g.text: J2 BC-250: 1 power LED +, 2 power LED -, 3 power button, 4 reset button

g.desc: J2 BC-250: 1 power LED +, 2 power LED -, 3 power button, 4 reset button

g.text: J1 ATX power supply: 1 PS_ON# (green, pin 16), 2 GND (black), 3 +5VSB (purple, pin 9)

g.desc: J1 ATX power supply: 1 PS_ON# (green, pin 16), 2 GND (black), 3 +5VSB (purple, pin 9)

g.text: BC-250 power controller, rev A. Same circuit and GPIO map as the perfboard build (docs/HARDWARE.md).

g.desc: BC-250 power controller, rev A. Same circuit and GPIO map as the perfboard build (docs/HARDWARE.md).

g.text: GPIO2, 8, 9 (strapping) and GPIO21 are unused. GPIO20 is the UART0 RX pin: never start UART0.

g.desc: GPIO2, 8, 9 (strapping) and GPIO21 are unused. GPIO20 is the UART0 RX pin: never start UART0.

g.text: The optos are open-collector switches to the common ground; they do not isolate anything here.

g.desc: The optos are open-collector switches to the common ground; they do not isolate anything here.

g.text: U1/U2: TLP521-2 (LTV-827, PC827 and EL827 are pin-compatible).

g.desc: U1/U2: TLP521-2 (LTV-827, PC827 and EL827 are pin-compatible).

g.text: Sense: BC-250 power LED current flows through the opto LED. Pull-up is internal (GPIO5), low = LED lit.

g.desc: Sense: BC-250 power LED current flows through the opto LED. Pull-up is internal (GPIO5), low = LED lit.

g.text: The XIAO 5V pin is USB VBUS: do not connect USB and +5VSB together unless D1 is fitted and JP2 is cut.

g.desc: The XIAO 5V pin is USB VBUS: do not connect USB and +5VSB together unless D1 is fitted and JP2 is cut.

g.text: JP2 is closed (D1 bypassed). Cut JP2 and fit D1 to allow USB and +5VSB together.

g.desc: JP2 is closed (D1 bypassed). Cut JP2 and fit D1 to allow USB and +5VSB together.
